detailsBlock.fullText: Emmanuel P. Ferrer. Bachelor of Technical-Vocational Teacher Education major in ICT Computer Programming, Technological University of the Philippines - Taguig, 4th Year. Deployed at President Diosdado Macapagal High School. School Year 2026-2027, 2nd Term. Field Study 2 (FS2-T). Ma'am Anna Tanto.

welcome: Hello, and welcome to my Field Study e-portfolio. Between September 23 and November 5, 2026, I spent every Wednesday and Thursday at President Diosdado Macapagal High School. It started as observation and became much more: I planned lessons, built materials, and taught real classes. This portfolio is not just a folder of documents. It is the story of how I changed, and I hope you enjoy reading it as much as I enjoyed living it.
